Sl. N Qty o. Brief description of work. Unit Rate Total Price The Tenderers are required to offer rates BELOW/ AT PAR/ ABO VE on below schedules. Schedule-A

1 Hiring of road vehicles (02 Nos.) Non-AC base model Hatch back (1500 KMS per month, cumulative 18000 k ms per year & category as specified in GeM) Maruti Su zuki Swift, Hyundai i10, Tat a Tiago or similar type, not more than four years old, o n the date of opening of te nder and in good working c ondition for the official use of ADEE/OP/BZA and ADME /P/BZA for a period of 36 m Vehicle 72 43,000 30,96,000 onths with Drivers with lice Month nse, minimum wages, ESI, EPF as applicable to be pai d to the drivers, Fuel, cons umables including regular maintenance, all the charg es associated with the vehi cle, exclusive of GST. (02 v ehicles x 36 months - 72 V ehicle Months) Rate per month for a run of 1500 KMs and 12 hours us age per day for all days of the month (day/night) Sub-total 30,96,000 GST @5% 1,54,800 Grand Total of for a per 32,50,80 iod of three years 0 (Rupees Thirty Two Lakhs Fifty thousand Eight Hundred only) NOTE TO PRICE SCHEDULE: 1. The price schedule is inclusive of GST. 2. The tenderer should go through the ‘SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT’ and 'SCOPE OF WORK' of th e tender booklet for proper assessment of the work involving parking, toll charges, Road tax, other statut ory duties & levies of vehicle if any and visit the site of the above work to have familiarized with the work ing conditions there in all respects before giving his offer. COMMERCIAL COMPLIANCE (IDENTIFICATION): (1) Tenderers should attach self-attested copy of PAN CARD & Photo Identification in Support o f their IDENTITY. (2) The documents attached to the tender document should be clear and legible for evaluation of tenders. Proper care to be taken in this regard. SCOPE OF WORK Name of the work: Hiring of road vehicles (02 Nos.) Non-AC base model Hatch back fo r the official use of ADEE/OP/BZA and ADME/P/BZA for a period of three years. 1. Two Nos. of Non-AC Vehiclesbase Model Hatch backin good working condition with driver is to be provided for official use of ADEE/OP/BZA AND ADME/P/BZAfor a period of three y ears.

2. The vehicle may be used anywhere in the jurisdiction of Vijayawada division and whole of Andhra Pradesh. 3. The drivers shall report with the vehicles normally at the residence of ADEE/OP/BZA and ADME/P/BZA at 08.00 hrs and the timings will be adjusted as per the requirement/necessit y. 4. Each vehicle shall operate for 12 hours a day, all days in the month for a run of 1500 KMs /month with cumulative run of 18000 KMs/year. 5. The work has to be carried out under the control of Supervisor in-charge. 6. The vehicle should be in good condition and must not be older than four years on the date of opening of tender.Otherwise, the bid shall be summarily rejected. 7. The vehicles should be any one of the following Non-AC 4 wheeler vehicles or their equival ent. i) Maruti Suzuki Swift ii) HyundaiGrand i10 NIOS iii) Tata Tiago 8. The vehicle should be in good running condition and be comfortable for travel. 9. The vehicles provided should have driver with valid license, supplied with fuel, Consuma bles and arrangements for regular maintenance. All the taxes, Toll gate fee etc., are to be p aid by the contractor as per the requirement. Contractor shall submit copies of valid vehicle RC book, valid driver license, valid insurance of vehicle, valid pollution certificate of vehicle and any other statutory documents required to be carried while driving to the supervisor in- charge and to the office of Sr.DEE/TRSO/BZA for commencement of the work. 10. The vehicles should comply with the pollution norms of the RTA and the pollution check sh ould be carried out periodically from an authorized agency and the valid certificate to that ef fect should be made available in the vehicles at all times. 11. The drivers of the vehicles should possess a cell phone round the clock for receiving instru ctions from the Railways regarding the movement of the vehicle. The cell phone should not b e kept in switched off condition at any time. Driver shall always be cautious while driving and over speeding shall always be prevented. 12. Apart from this, in case the contractor wants to change the vehicle at any time during th e contract period, he may do so by providing the new vehicle by satisfying the tender condi tions. However, to change the vehicle, the contractor shall obtain the approval of Sr.DEE/T RSO/BZA. 13. Disaster Management: The vehicles and equipment provided by the contractor can be draf ted by Railway administration in case of accidents/natural calamities involving human lives f or this purpose, payment will be made duly operating the item as a non-schedule item as per the norms and powers delegated to the Railway. 14. Vehicle driver should wear proper neat and clean formal uniform with shoes. Identity card shall be issued to the driver signed by the contractor with Contract No., Name of the person, Place of work etc., and affixed at a conspicuous place on his/her dress while performing Rail way duties. 15. Railway shall not be responsible in case of any accident or mishap involving the road vehi cles and will not be liable to pay any damage/compensation due to the accident of road vehi cles to the contractor or any third party. 16. In case of any damage or loss caused to the Railway property due to the accident involvin g the contractor's vehicle, the contractor shall be fully liable to pay the loss of damage sustai ned to Railways. 17. Any illegal article/material transported at any time in the vehicle will result in termination of contract and the PG available will stand forfeited. No correspondence in this matter will b e entertained. 18. Cost of parking of vehicles, if any, will have to be borne entirely by the contractor. 19. The contractor is solely responsible for the safety and security of his vehicles along with d rivers and the Railway will not have any liability in case of thefts/damages, legal disputes etc . 20. The contractor shall not have any claims for increase of rate or any hike in the price of fuel etc., during the period of currency and the same accepted rate will remain applicable across the entire period of the contract.

21. The driver should be provided with all essential tools, accessories and spares and be fully capable to attend to minor repairs and breakdowns in case of emergency. 22. The drivers should report with the vehicles at any time during Emergency/Breakdown on intimation or over phone from the supervisor in-charge. 23. The driver should be healthy, free from contagious diseases and not more than 60 years old. 24. The vehicles should be provided with a sign board ‘ON HIRE TO DEPARTMENT OF RAI LWAYS’ in bilingual (Hindi & English) in proper place in front as well as rear side. 25. The vehicles should be kept in the office premises during night time or as advised by the supervisor in-charge. 26. No other person except the drivers and Railway Officials on duty should be allowed in the vehicle. 27. The vehicles should be in good condition and all repairs are to be borne by the suppliers at their own cost. 28. The drivers should always be present with the vehicle so that there will be no difficulty to get him whenever he is required for driving the vehicle. 29. The drivers should normally be able to read and write in Telugu and English. He should h ave good and pleasing manners and behavior. He should not smoke while driving and shoul d not be under intoxication while on duty. The driver should make his own arrangements fo r breakfast, tea, and lunch etc while on duty. 30. Any change of driver, or temporary replacement of the vehicle in exceptional cases for a short period, requires prior permission of the concerned officer (ADEE/OP/BZA or ADME/P/B ZA). A permanent change of vehicle requires approval as per point 12. 31. The vehicles will be utilized as required by the Railway administration within the state i.e. Andhra Pradesh. The timings will be adjusted as per the requirement/necessity. 32. The running cost of the vehicles should be borne by the contractor himself. 33. Wages of drivers, repair charges, maintenance charges, breakdown charges, license taxe s, cost of fuel etc., are to be borne by the contractor only. 34. The vehicles will ply anywhere in Andhra Pradesh but normally based at Vijayawada. 35. Suitable penalties will be levied in case of failure of contractor during the contract period as mentioned in clause 4.8 of Special Conditions of Contract. .
